system_prompt_style.note: KG-Linker prompt template with question/schema/graph_context variables.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Given a user query and the KG schema1, the LLM is prompted to generate relevant graph artifacts
env_context_strategy.note: Schema injected up front plus agentic traversal and scoring/embedding retrieval of triplets.

context_compaction.note: Paper notes lack of context pruning; no compaction mechanism located in evidence.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Extract all topic entities from the question and useful intermediate entities from the graph context (if pro- vided) within <entities> tags.
tool_call_format.note: Artifacts parsed from tagged text; openCypher query in <opencypher> tags is executed.

tool_count.evidence_quote: Entity Linking Path Retrieval Graph Query Retrieval
tool_count.note: Entity linking, path retrieval, graph-query retrieval, triplet retrieval; these are harness-invoked tools, not model-facing function schemas.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: we consider the KG as the sole source of external information
edit_primitive.note: No file editing tool; the system answers KGQA questions.

protocol_standardization.note: No MCP/A2A code appears in the byokg-rag source tree listing.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: At each iteration t, we obtain one-hop candi- date tripletsT t q and prompt the LLM to select the most relevant relationsRt q.
loop_primitives.note: Outer fixed pipeline (link -> retrieve -> refine, TR=2) with inner agentic ReAct-like traversal.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Identify all relevant relationship paths that connect the entities and can be used to answer the question within <paths> tags.
planning_granularity.note: Relation paths are prompt-elicited artifacts, not a stored plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Note that those graph artifacts can be generated by a single LLM call.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Note that those graph artifacts can be generated by a single LLM call.

human_in_loop.note: Loop runs to completion without human gating.

short_term_state.note: Accumulated graph context set C plus artifact sets carried across iterations.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: our cur- rent work considers the KG as the sole source of external information

state_persistence.note: Context initialised empty each run; no resume path in evidence.

self_verification.evidence_quote: which are the query execution results overG.
self_verification.note: Path retrieval 'executes and validates the LLM-generated paths' and a cypher error-feedback test file exists, but no self-critique/judge in the default loop.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: By default, we have TR = 2 iterations, but we include self-termination when the KG-Linker does not pro- vide new entities to link.
retry_policy.note: Refinement iterations rather than task retries; BYOKG_MAX_RETRIES=10 is an API-transport retry.

rollback.evidence_quote: BYOKG-RAG leverages diverse graph tools to retrieve context
rollback.note: Read-only retrieval over the KG; nothing to roll back.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The process is terminated until self-termination (empty entity set to explore) or until we reach the maximum agentic iterations TA, defaulting to TA = 3.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: BYOKG_MAX_TOKENS       - Max tokens for LLM generation (default: 4096)

timeouts.note: No timeout settings among the documented env vars.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: When executing graph queries, we store the KG in Nep- tuneAnalytics4 and query the database with open- Cypher5.
execution_isolation.note: Library runs in-process; queries execute on a remote graph database service.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: This step requires the graph to be stored in a format that supports the execution of the generated graph lan- guage queries.
filesystem_access.note: Agent actions touch the knowledge graph store only, not a filesystem.

network_policy.note: No network restriction mechanism in evidence; AWS APIs called directly.

permission_model.evidence_quote: which are the query execution results overG.
permission_model.note: Generated openCypher queries are executed without an authorisation layer in the evidence.

guardrails.note: No filters or action policies located in the evidence.
